Primary Open Loop Fueling (Alternate)
table.description:
Replacement for Primary Open Loop Fueling plus its knock additive, used only when the calibration switch 'Open Loop Fueling. Edit with Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate) if you enable it.
Details: When used: only when cal 0x2F79A bit 4 is set (read; 2017 0x36B76, 2018 0x37FF2). The bit is the first argument of 0x0CE854 (call in 0x0C589C, read). With it set, 0x0CE854 uses this table + cal 0x18DDC in place of the base table plus the DAM-scaled additive, while DAM16 FFF811AE < cal 0x18DDD; otherwise Primary Open Loop Fueling + cal 0x18DDC (read). The TGV/AVCS group has its own alternate (Primary Open Loop Fueling (TGV/AVCS Group, Alternate)); edit both if you enable the switch. LV9N101C: located from LF75404S 05AC80 by its caller in the decompiled code (read). Evidence: fn 0x0BBE18 reads it where LF75404S 0x0CE854 reads the 2015 table (read); 24x10 here vs 24x20 in 2015, whose second axis has padding points 221-230 that this build lacks (read). Descriptor 04E960. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
Special-start copy of Cranking Fuel Pedal Multiplier.
Details: When used: start type FFF8A6E7 = 3. 0x0CD7E4 (read): FFF8A67E = this(accelerator FFF88A5E), updated only while rpm FFF8CD54 <= cal 0x1CBD8 (4000 rpm). Injection Timing (Double Injection, 1st)
table.description:
Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Angle of the first pulse when two injections per cycle are used, in normal fuel mode (0x0CB394, read). Injection angle for FFF8B054 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. LV9N101C: located from LF75404S 05AF94 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 04EC74. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Injection Timing (Double Injection, 2nd)
table.description:
Angle of the second pulse with two injections per cycle.
Details: Units (FU_UNITS): degrees BTDC of the compression TDC, stored directly (0x0CFC20: code = 1440 - x, then clamped to 0.5-540 BTDC; read). Same scale as every other Injection Timing / injection-angle table. When used: Angle of the second pulse with two injections per cycle (0x0CB604, read). Injection angle for FFF8B056 (0x0C589C via 0x0CFC20-style helper, read): computed only while FFF99844 is 2 or 3 (otherwise a fixed 0x1FE) (0x0CFC20, read). 0x0CB394 uses B054 for two injections and B058 for three in normal fuel mode (read); the Double Injection tables cover 1100-3200 rpm, the Triple Injection tables 600-1300 rpm. LV9N101C: located from LF75404S 05AFA8 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 04EC88. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Double Injection Split
table.description:
Share of the fuel in the first of two injections; the second gets the rest.
Details: Share of the fuel in the first of two injections (0x0D05D8 -> FFF8B068 -> FFF8A6D1, read); the second gets the rest (0x0D0D50). Limited by FFF8A6DA (read). LV9N101C: located from LF75404S 05B1A0 by the code that reads it (read). Descriptor 04EDF4. Confidence: inferred.

Knock Background Window Step (Event 1, Channel 8)
table.description:
Knock-detection background step for event slot 1, frequency channel 8.
Details: event slot FFF8CDC0 = 1 (Event 1), knock channel 8 of 8 (index 7 of FFF8CDB0), which is masked: bit 7 of cal 0x1B97C is set (0xC1 = channels 1, 7 and 8 off for every slot). 0x0E51E4 (read) then writes a fixed ratio for the channel instead of 256 x measured/reference, and the reference ref_7 (the only place this step enters, statics FFF84AB4..FFF84AD0 read only by 0x0E51E4, ram_xref) is not used; the reference copies FFF8C130.. have no reader. So editing it has no effect unless that cal bit is cleared, which would make the channel count (then this would be the background step for FFF8C180[7] when FFF8A7C2 changes; overlap flag FFF8A7D2, gain curve cal 0x26F6F). Knock signal processing 0x0E51E4 (read; called once per knock window from 0x0E43B8 with load FFF8A616, after the event chain 0x0E433C): for the event slot FFF8CDC0 (1-4, the slot of the Knock Threshold tables) each of 8 knock channels i gets a reference ref_i = 32 x step_i + g x background_i, and the channel ratio is 256 x FFF8CDB0[i] / (ref_i / 32), i.e. measured / reference with 256 = equal (0x0E51E4 tail, read). Channels with their bit set in cal 0x1B97C..0x1B97F give 0; a channel flagged in FFF8CEED (driver flag, value at its lower limit, inferred) gives 256. The ratios are sorted and the largest min(cal 0x1B988, 5) = 3 are summed into the knock intensity FFF8C1C0[slot], which 0x0E80B4/0x0E8654 compare with Knock Threshold (read). The measured channels come from the knock sensor ADC: 0x1E7868 DMA-collects 32-sample blocks, 0x1E725A runs FFT-style butterflies, 0x1E73A4 takes sqrt(re^2+im^2) of 8 selected bins (pointer tables 0x34A88/0x34AA8), and 0x1E7724 sums them over the window into FFF8D1D4[8] -> FFF8CDB0[8] (read), so the 8 channels are 8 frequency bins of the knock sensor signal (inferred). background_i is the per-slot channel background FFF8C180.. (slot 1) / C190.. / C1A0.. / C1B0.. (slot 4), a lag filter of the measured channel kept by 0x0E4500 when the event is not knocking, floored at the per-channel rpm curve FFF8C0D8 (0x0E22A4) (read). step_i is this table family: it is non-zero only on the one event where the slot's window-length flag changes: +table when the flag goes 0 -> 1 (window switched to the extended length) and -table when it goes 1 -> 0 (back to the nominal length); on that event the reference is also floored at 32 x FFF8C0D8[i] (read). The flag is set when the extended knock window is used (0x0E20E0, read: B11A = nominal + Knock Window Length Extension only while timing FFF8A744 <= Knock Window Extension Timing Threshold and the extended window ends before the event angle). The step is skipped (0) and g is changed instead when the slot's overlap flag (FFF8A7D2..D5) changes while the window is nominal: g = gain curve cal (implicit rpm axis, x/32) on 0 -> 1 and min(1024 / gain, cal 0x26FAF = 64) on 1 -> 0, else g = 32 (x1.0) (read). On the event after a flag change 0x0E4500 resets the background almost fully to the new measurement (filter weight 255/256 while FFF8A7BC is set, read), so the step only bridges that single event: a larger value raises that channel's reference when the window lengthens (lower intensity, less likely to count as knock on that event) and lowers it when the window shortens (read). Axes: rpm FFF8CDC2 (x 31.25 + 500, 500-4000 rpm) x load FFF8A616 (read). Evidence: knock processing 0x0D1528 (= LF75404S 0x0E51E4) (read): per event slot (FFF8BFB0 == 4, then == cStack_a8 / cStack_a4 / cStack_a0 for 3 / 2 / 1) it reads 8 tables, one per channel, through 0x18DD30(desc, FFF8BFB2,...) with stride 0x14: slot 4 04FC0C..04FC98, slot 3 04FB6C..04FBF8, slot 2 04FACC..04FB58, slot 1 04FA2C..04FAB8, as LF75404S reads 05BFD8.., 05BF38.., 05BE98.., 05BDF8.. (read). slot 1 channel 8. The automatic pick 04FAA4 is channel 7 (shared with the channel 7 entry). Confidence: read.

Evidence: knock processing 0x0D1528 (= LF75404S 0x0E51E4) (read): per event slot (FFF8BFB0 == 4, then == cStack_a8 / cStack_a4 / cStack_a0 for 3 / 2 / 1) it reads 8 tables, one per channel, through 0x18DD30(desc, FFF8BFB2,...) with stride 0x14: slot 4 04FC0C..04FC98, slot 3 04FB6C..04FBF8, slot 2 04FACC..04FB58, slot 1 04FA2C..04FAB8, as LF75404S reads 05BFD8.., 05BF38.., 05BE98.., 05BDF8.. (read). slot 4 channel 8 (was not placed; the code pick 04FC84 is channel 7; layout data 024A92 agree). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant for a cold-idle mode used when stopped below a coolant threshold.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 4 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Evidence: 0x0DD598 mode 4 -> 0x20FD4 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description: Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.

table.name: Electrical Load Idle Air Hold Release (Alternator Command)
Idle Air from Throttle Area (Torque Request)
Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Evidence: base-air reader 0x0DC820, mode 4 with FFF89D01 bit 4 (TGV closed) clear -> 0x21502 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (Cold Idle, Mode 4, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base idle air by coolant for the cold-idle mode 4 with the TGVs commanded closed.
Details: When used: idle mode 4, entered from mode 5 when stopped with coolant below cal 0x24E94 for cal 0x24E96 passes. 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Evidence: base-air reader 0x0DC820, mode 4 with FFF89D01 bit 4 set -> 0x21422 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 1
table.description: Crankshaft roughness level, by rpm and load, that confirms channel 1 of the P219A A/F imbalance monitor. It sets no code by itself; P219A needs both this and A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 1 exceeded. Raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).

table.name: A/F Imbalance Monitor Crank Roughness Threshold 2
table.description: Crankshaft roughness level that confirms channel 2 of the P219A monitor (paired with A/F Imbalance Monitor Swing Threshold 2). Lower than Threshold 1, so more sensitive. Sets no code by itself; raising cells makes a fault harder (the maximum value = never).

table.name: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (AT/CVT)

AT/CVT version of Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain; only used with an automatic/CVT coding, no effect on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings only, while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear. Same role as Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain (0x0F6D98, read). Selection: Transient Fuel Throttle-Rate Gain is used while FFF8A618 bit 0 is set, which is always on the manual coding (cal 0x2F794 bit 1 clear, 0x0B8544, read); the (AT/CVT) table is used on AT/CVT codings while FFF8A618 bit 0 is clear (FFF886B0 bit 6 set after the first cal 0x34978 passes, not identified); the table when the manual flag FFF886AB bit 7 is set and either bit 0 is clear or cal 0x2F794 bit 2 is clear (rule: (A618 b0 = 0 or (0x2F794 b2 = 0 and 886AB b7)) ?: this one, read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C Off)
table.description:
Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C off).
Replaces the gear tables when FFF8AE0A (10 ms passes since FFF8A88F was last non-zero, 0x0B93C8) is above cal 0x20C0C; the cal is 65535 and the compare is unsigned greater-than on a u16, so it can never be true (0x0B93FC, read); FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic)
table.description:
Alternate A/C-switch timing retard amount, by an unidentified input.
0x0D8E3C (called from 0x0DF02C; args read: FFF88A2D bit 0, cal 0x1D0AE bit 0, FFF8A9A3 bit 0, FFF8A9A2 bit 6, FFF8A65F bit 7) loads FFF8B0CC with this table (by FFF8A8C7) instead of cal 0x2FE82 (2560 = 5 degrees) only when its second argument, the calibration bit 0x1D0AE bit 0, is set. With that bit set the trigger also changes from the A/C engagement edge (FFF8A9A2 bit 6) to FFF8A9A3 bit 0. B0CC >> 8 is subtracted from the final timing sum (0x0D9E40) while the A/C Cut Timing Retard Hold counter runs, then decays (read). Axis FFF8A8C7 is not identified: 0x116034 writes it as a latched copy of FFF8A8C6 (latch conditions involve FFF88B8B bit 0 and FFF8A9A3 bit 1; not worked out in detail), and FFF8A8C6 comes from 0x115F80, which takes it from FFF88B91 (a received input byte, meaning not identified); FFF8A8C6 is read by several other functions together with the same cal bit 0x1D0AE bit 0 (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Target (AT Drive Range)
table.description:
AT version of Closed-Pedal Timing Target, used with the pedal released while the transmission is probably in a drive range.
Details: When used: only with the automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear), while the debounced range state FFF8A7D9 (0x0EA0E0 from FFF8CE63, which 0x06B68C builds from the discrete inputs FFF8A2A1) is 1 or 2 (in a drive range, inferred). Never on a manual car (read). Same role as Closed-Pedal Timing Target. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Evidence: 0x0F4060 (pair of 0x108BAC; identical in LV9N101C/LV9N100F): only two lookup groups, no alternate set (no counterpart of ref selector param_15; the disassembly loads exactly the 10 descriptors 0x50B4C..0x50C00 and 0x50B9C/0x50BB0); group 1 used when param_6 && p7 < cal 0x26035 (= ref !(0x2A0C1 <= p7)) && param_14, group 2 when param_14 == 0, as in the ref. group 2, base (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.
Details: When used: whenever FFF88ADA bit 7 (manual-transmission coding) is clear, i.e. on the AT/CVT coding. The A/B weight FFF8AE26 (0x0B9C78) starts at 0 and its step cals 0x22FBE/0x22FC0 are 0, so it stays 0 and the output is this table alone; the matching non-AT/CVT table is then ignored (read). FFF88ADA bit 7 is set on the manual coding, so this table is unused on manual cars. Driver-requested torque from rpm and pedal (0x0BB670, read): FFF8AEB4 = A x FFF8AE26/32768 + B x (1 - FFF8AE26/32768), torque above the zero point, into FFF8AEB4; FFF8AE26 ramps between 0 and 32768 under a condition (0x0B9C78). Table B of map set 2 = Drive Mode 1, Default (0x0BDBD8 combines the four sets by the drive-mode byte FFF8A8C1 and per-mode scale cals 0x1FAFE-0x1FB00; SI-Drive positions: mode 4 = Sport Sharp, mode 2 = Sport, mode 3 = Intelligent (least torque for a given pedal in both images), mode 1 = the default used when no valid SI-Drive request is received, and the only set on cars without SI-Drive). KEEP Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor) identical (inferred safety copy). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor
table.description:
Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x20F04 = 1, 2 or 3. Barometric part of the air density factor FFF8AE9E. 0x0BB0A4 (read): FFF8AE9E = Baro Factor(FFF88A36) x IAT Factor(FFF88A48) / 16384. 0x0BB0EC / 0x0BB118 copy it to FFF8AEA0 / FFF8AEA2 only when cal 0x20F04 is 1 or 3 / 1 or 2 and FFF88E28 bit 2 / FFF88E2A bit 0 are clear, else 16384 (x1.0). FFF8AEA2 divides the external (CAN) torque limit in 0x0BB1AC: limit = 16000 + FFF88DF6 x 160 x 16384 / FFF8AEA2 (read; the limit byte is inferred to come from another controller, my research notes); FFF8AEA0 goes to 0x116158. The product is the air density relative to 101.3 kPa and 25 degC. p16 (read): FFF88DF6 = CAN 0x149 byte 4 (mailbox 1, TCM frame group: decoding gated by the U0101/U0402 status and forced off by the MT coding FFF886AB b7, which then loads cal 0x572D0), decoder 0x085D20. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Evidence: idle-speed reader 0x0DD598: mode 6 -> 0x21014 (read); LV9N100F data equal LF75404S's tables exactly (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7): idle speed by coolant once the car has moved off before the engine is warm. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 8 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Evidence: 0x0DD598 mode 8 -> 0x21054 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding, while the in-Drive idle condition FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant): automatic coding, neutral input clear, pedal released, slow) and afterwards until the in-Drive idle air reduction FFF8B160 has ramped back to its target. Never on a manual car (inferred from that chain). 0x0F2248 (read): when FFF8A7E4 bit 4 is set, B242 = this(coolant) << 6 (12.5 rpm per count) replaces the idle-mode target chain. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:

Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C Off)
table.description:
Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C off).
Replaces the gear tables when FFF8AE0A (10 ms passes since FFF8A88F was last non-zero, 0x0B93C8) is above cal 0x20C0C; the cal is 65535 and the compare is unsigned greater-than on a u16, so it can never be true (0x0B93FC, read); FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Full-Cut Shortcut Hold
table.description:
Time, by rpm, after which all cylinders would be cut at once under unidentified conditions.
0x0B93FC (read; input rpm FFF8CE9C = stack arg s16, checked at 0x0B9428/0x0B9464, the decompiler drops it) counts passes while FFF88E62 bit 0 is set and compares the count with this(rpm); stage 4 (all cylinders cut) is forced when that count is reached, FFF8A8AE bit 7 is set and the staging counter FFF8AE16 is above cal 0x228DE. the table is also 65535 (655 s) everywhere. FFF88E62 bit 0 and FFF8A8AE bit 7 are not identified. Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). In the gear tables, row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 4 (0x0DBB20, read). Phase factor (x/255) by the rpm swing count FFF8A75E. With gear FFF88FCE = 0 or above 6 no table is read and the last factor is held (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic)
table.description:
Alternate A/C-switch timing retard amount, by an unidentified input.
0x0D8E3C (called from 0x0DF02C; args read: FFF88A2D bit 0, cal 0x1D0AE bit 0, FFF8A9A3 bit 0, FFF8A9A2 bit 6, FFF8A65F bit 7) loads FFF8B0CC with this table (by FFF8A8C7) instead of cal 0x2FE82 (2560 = 5 degrees) only when its second argument, the calibration bit 0x1D0AE bit 0, is set. With that bit set the trigger also changes from the A/C engagement edge (FFF8A9A2 bit 6) to FFF8A9A3 bit 0. B0CC >> 8 is subtracted from the final timing sum (0x0D9E40) while the A/C Cut Timing Retard Hold counter runs, then decays (read). Axis FFF8A8C7 is not identified: 0x116034 writes it as a latched copy of FFF8A8C6 (latch conditions involve FFF88B8B bit 0 and FFF8A9A3 bit 1; not worked out in detail), and FFF8A8C6 comes from 0x115F80, which takes it from FFF88B91 (a received input byte, meaning not identified); FFF8A8C6 is read by several other functions together with the same cal bit 0x1D0AE bit 0 (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Target (AT Drive Range)
table.description:
AT version of Closed-Pedal Timing Target, used with the pedal released while the transmission is probably in a drive range.
Details: When used: only with the automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear), while the debounced range state FFF8A7D9 (0x0EA0E0 from FFF8CE63, which 0x06B68C builds from the discrete inputs FFF8A2A1) is 1 or 2 (in a drive range, inferred). Never on a manual car (read). Same role as Closed-Pedal Timing Target. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Evidence: 0x0F4060 (pair of 0x108BAC; identical in LV9N101C/LV9N100F): only two lookup groups, no alternate set (no counterpart of ref selector param_15; the disassembly loads exactly the 10 descriptors 0x50B4C..0x50C00 and 0x50B9C/0x50BB0); group 1 used when param_6 && p7 < cal 0x26035 (= ref !(0x2A0C1 <= p7)) && param_14, group 2 when param_14 == 0, as in the ref. group 2, base (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.
Details: When used: whenever FFF88ADA bit 7 (manual-transmission coding) is clear, i.e. on the AT/CVT coding. The A/B weight FFF8AE26 (0x0B9C78) starts at 0 and its step cals 0x22FBE/0x22FC0 are 0, so it stays 0 and the output is this table alone; the matching non-AT/CVT table is then ignored (read). FFF88ADA bit 7 is set on the manual coding, so this table is unused on manual cars. Driver-requested torque from rpm and pedal (0x0BB670, read): FFF8AEB4 = A x FFF8AE26/32768 + B x (1 - FFF8AE26/32768), torque above the zero point, into FFF8AEB4; FFF8AE26 ramps between 0 and 32768 under a condition (0x0B9C78). Table B of map set 2 = Drive Mode 1, Default (0x0BDBD8 combines the four sets by the drive-mode byte FFF8A8C1 and per-mode scale cals 0x1FAFE-0x1FB00; SI-Drive positions: mode 4 = Sport Sharp, mode 2 = Sport, mode 3 = Intelligent (least torque for a given pedal in both images), mode 1 = the default used when no valid SI-Drive request is received, and the only set on cars without SI-Drive). KEEP Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor) identical (inferred safety copy). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 4, Sport Sharp, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 with FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 2. 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1 and pedal FFF8AF00): with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else 255 = x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (89, about 5 km/h, hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. So these limit how fast the driver's torque request may rise (tip-in), in two stages. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA that indexes boost target and wastegate duty (my research notes). The torque monitor (0x1877B4) reads the same bytes through its own descriptor, so it stays consistent. Drive mode = FFF8A8C1 (2, 3, 4 or other; which value is which SI-Drive position: see the Requested Torque entries, see my research notes). Same data bytes are also referenced by descriptor(s) 05F714. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: External Torque Limit Baro Factor
table.description:
Air-density correction (barometric part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x20F04 = 1, 2 or 3. Barometric part of the air density factor FFF8AE9E. 0x0BB0A4 (read): FFF8AE9E = Baro Factor(FFF88A36) x IAT Factor(FFF88A48) / 16384. 0x0BB0EC / 0x0BB118 copy it to FFF8AEA0 / FFF8AEA2 only when cal 0x20F04 is 1 or 3 / 1 or 2 and FFF88E28 bit 2 / FFF88E2A bit 0 are clear, else 16384 (x1.0). FFF8AEA2 divides the external (CAN) torque limit in 0x0BB1AC: limit = 16000 + FFF88DF6 x 160 x 16384 / FFF8AEA2 (read; the limit byte is inferred to come from another controller, my research notes); FFF8AEA0 goes to 0x116158. The product is the air density relative to 101.3 kPa and 25 degC. p16 (read): FFF88DF6 = CAN 0x149 byte 4 (mailbox 1, TCM frame group: decoding gated by the U0101/U0402 status and forced off by the MT coding FFF886AB b7, which then loads cal 0x572D0), decoder 0x085D20. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: External Torque Limit IAT Factor
table.description:
Air-density correction (intake temperature part) applied to a torque limit received over CAN, probably from the transmission controller.
Details: When used: only with cal 0x20F04 = 1, 2 or 3. Intake-air-temperature part of the air density factor FFF8AE9E. 0x0BB0A4 (read): FFF8AE9E = Baro Factor(FFF88A36) x IAT Factor(FFF88A48) / 16384. 0x0BB0EC / 0x0BB118 copy it to FFF8AEA0 / FFF8AEA2 only when cal 0x20F04 is 1 or 3 / 1 or 2 and FFF88E28 bit 2 / FFF88E2A bit 0 are clear, else 16384 (x1.0). FFF8AEA2 divides the external (CAN) torque limit in 0x0BB1AC: limit = 16000 + FFF88DF6 x 160 x 16384 / FFF8AEA2 (read; the limit byte is inferred to come from another controller, my research notes); FFF8AEA0 goes to 0x116158. The product is the air density relative to 101.3 kPa and 25 degC. p16 (read): FFF88DF6 = CAN 0x149 byte 4 (mailbox 1, TCM frame group: decoding gated by the U0101/U0402 status and forced off by the MT coding FFF886AB b7, which then loads cal 0x572D0), decoder 0x085D20. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm Idle, AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Warm idle speed target by coolant for automatic/CVT cars only; a manual car never uses this table.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT transmission coding. With the manual coding the idle mode never becomes 6 (0x0F2BCC passes the mode through unchanged while FFF88ADA bit 7 is set, and 0x0F354C produces only modes 1-5 and 7, read), so on a manual car edit Mode 5. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 6 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274. Implicit coolant axis -40..110 degC in 10 degC steps (lookup 0x7414, read). Evidence: idle-speed reader 0x0DD598: mode 6 -> 0x21014 (read); LV9N100F data equal LF75404S's tables exactly (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, AT/CVT, Mode 8)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Speed Target (Warm-Up Drive-Off, Mode 7): idle speed by coolant once the car has moved off before the engine is warm. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 7 is mapped to 8 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (read, 0x0F2BCC). Never on a manual car. 0x0F1BCC selects this boot-format table by idle mode FFF8A7F0 = 8 and coolant; the result B238 is ramped (0x0F1D00) and becomes the idle target FFF8B236 through the minimum-speed max() in 0x0F2274 (read). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Evidence: 0x0DD598 mode 8 -> 0x21054 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Speed Target (In Drive, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Idle speed target by coolant while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive with the brake on (pedal released, slow). Never used on a manual car (inferred).
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding, while the in-Drive idle condition FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant): automatic coding, neutral input clear, pedal released, slow) and afterwards until the in-Drive idle air reduction FFF8B160 has ramped back to its target. Never on a manual car (inferred from that chain). 0x0F2248 (read): when FFF8A7E4 bit 4 is set, B242 = this(coolant) << 6 (12.5 rpm per count) replaces the idle-mode target chain. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Target Ramp Rate (AT/CVT, Mode 1 to 6)
table.description:
How fast the idle speed target moves (by coolant) when idle switches from mode 1 (engine stopped) to mode 6 (AT/CVT warm idle). Larger = quicker change. Automatic/CVT only: these modes never occur on a manual car, so this table has no effect there.
Details: 0x0F1DD0 (read; selection checked in the disassembly 0x0F1DD0..0x0F2148): the target ramp step B23E is chosen on a change of idle mode FFF8A7F0 (previous -> new) and kept while the mode stays the same; the target B23C (4 x B238) moves toward the new mode's Idle Speed Target by this step every pass (0x0F1D00). Coolant FFF88A44 axis. Mode 1 -> 1 uses step 0. This table: mode 1 -> 6. Modes 6/8 only occur with the AT/CVT coding: 0x0F2BCC passes A7F6 through when FFF88ADA bit7 is set and 0x0F354C itself only yields 1-5/7, so this step is never used by this MT calibration (read). p16 (read): 0x0F1D00 runs every 10 ms (module 0x0EE338), so rpm/s = shown rpm-per-pass x 100. Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded open. Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target so idle feedback does not have to make up the difference. The TGV Closed table is used whenever the TGVs are commanded closed, which is the normal state at low torque, so change both together.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGVs closed) is clear (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). Evidence: base-air reader 0x0DC820, mode 6 with FFF89D01 bit 4 (TGV closed) clear -> 0x21542 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Base Air (AT/CVT, Mode 6, TGV Closed)
table.description:
Base (open-loop) idle air by coolant in warm idle on automatic/CVT cars only (never used on a manual car), used while the TGVs are commanded closed (the normal state at low torque, probably including warm idle). Change it together with the matching Idle Speed Target and the normal Idle Base Air table for this mode.
Details: When used: only with the automatic/CVT coding: mode 5 is mapped to 6 while FFF8A7E2 bit 0 is clear (AT state code FFF8A7DD = 0 or 5, 0x0EC7A4; physical meaning not settled). Never on a manual car (read, 0x0F2BCC). 0x0F0D24: base idle air B20C by idle mode FFF8A7F0 and coolant, this table while FFF8A881 bit 4 (TGV close command) is set (read). Scale as Idle Base Air (Mode 5). Raise it with this mode's idle speed target so the feedback need not cover the difference (inferred). Implicit coolant axis -40..110 C in 10 C steps (lookup 0x7414). FFF8A881 bit 4 is the normal TGV-close command (0x10DEFC, set mainly by the timed close request FFF8A883 bit 5 from 0x10E180 when requested torque, coolant and air flow are below the TGV thresholds; the same bit selects every TGV-closed table), not a forced or fault state (read). At a settled warm idle the request conditions hold, so the TGVs are normally commanded closed and the TGV Closed table is probably the one in use (inferred). Evidence: base-air reader 0x0DC820, mode 6 with FFF89D01 bit 4 set -> 0x21462 (read; same per-mode layout as the mode 5 tables placed earlier). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, Coolant)
table.description:
Idle air taken away, by coolant, while an automatic/CVT car idles in Drive (pedal released, slow) to offset the load of the transmission. Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: only while FFF8A7E4 bit 0 is set (0x0F38D0, read): automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear) and the neutral input FFF88ADA bit 6 clear, accelerator released, speed FFF99835 within cals 0x2583F..0x25841, rpm below cal 0x25842 and below @025886(coolant), no speed-sensor/CAN faults; so never on a manual car (read). 0x0EAA40 (read): FFF8B162 = this(coolant) + Idle Air Reduction In Drive (RPM Error)(rpm - target rpm FFF8B236, coolant) + a ramp term (cals 0x25838..0x2583C), >= 0, capped by @025846(coolant); FFF8B160 follows it at cal 0x25834/0x25836 (86) per pass and is subtracted at half weight from the idle air FFF8B200 (0x0F0AF8, read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Reduction In Drive (AT/CVT, RPM Error)

Details: When used: see Idle Air Reduction In Drive (Coolant) (automatic coding only). 0x0EAA40 (read): added to the coolant term with the rpm error FFF8CE9C - FFF8B236 (s16, rpm x 5.12) and coolant FFF88A44 as axes. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward (AT/CVT, State 0/5)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT version of Idle Air Target-Change Feed-Forward, used in two transmission states only: extra or less idle air applied immediately when the idle speed target changes, by the size of the step.
Details: 0x0ECA08 (read; call 0x0ECA88/0x0ECA94 R5 checked): while FFF88A26 bit0 (idle, inferred), engine running (FFF88A27 bit0 clear) and FFF99835 below cal 0x259C8 (255, i.e. always), B1AE = this(new target - ramped target = B236 - B23C/4, capped at cal 0x259CA = 1000 rpm); B1AE enters the idle air at half weight. A positive step (target raised) adds air ahead of the ramp. Used when FFF8A7E2 bit0 is clear (bit0 = FFF8A7DD in 1..4 or 6, 0x0F38B0). Confidence: read.

table.name: Idle Converter Slip Threshold (In Gear, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Automatic/CVT only: converter slip, by coolant, needed for the ECU to treat the car as stopped in gear for idle control (probably torque-converter slip). Never used on a manual car.
Details: When used: AT/CVT codings, standstill in gear. table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C Off)
table.description:
Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C off).
Replaces the gear tables when FFF8AE0A (10 ms passes since FFF8A88F was last non-zero, 0x0B93C8) is above cal 0x20C0C; the cal is 65535 and the compare is unsigned greater-than on a u16, so it can never be true (0x0B93FC, read); FFF8A9A2 bit 7 clear (A/C not engaged, inferred; see the A/C On tables). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Alternate Set, A/C On)
table.description:
Alternate decel fuel cut staging (A/C on).
Replaces the gear tables when FFF8AE0A (10 ms passes since FFF8A88F was last non-zero, 0x0B93C8) is above cal 0x20C0C; the cal is 65535 and the compare is unsigned greater-than on a u16, so it can never be true (0x0B93FC, read); FFF8A9A2 bit 7 set: the A/C engaged flag FFF8A9A2 bit 6 confirmed for cal 0x396F0 (2) passes above cal 0x396EE rpm (0 rpm), 0x122AC4 (read; A/C identity of bit 6 inferred, as in the existing A/C entries). Decel fuel cut cylinder staging, 0x0B93FC (called from the 10 ms torque module 0x0BE694; all 27 arguments checked against the push order at 0x0BF7D4..0x0BF890, read). Row = rpm band of FFF8CE9C (cals 0x20C02..0x20C0A: 1 below 1800, 2 below 2800, 3 below 3800, 4 below 4800, 5 below 5800, 6 from 5800 rpm); column n = the time, in 10 ms passes after the decel fuel cut condition starts, from which n cylinders are cut. How it works (read): gear FFF88FCE, rpm band and the A/C flag are latched on the pass where FFF8A63D bit 2 clears, i.e. when the closed-pedal condition of 0x0C06F0 becomes true (pedal released FFF88C64 bit 5, rpm/25 >= resume threshold FFF8A62E, FFF88A76 >= cal 0x23702 = 6 s after start, no inhibit flag). The cut condition FFF8A63D bit 0 = bit 1 and not bit 2 (0x0C0FCC); bit 1 sets at rpm >= FFF8AED4 = FFF8A62E x 128 + FFF8AECE and holds down to FFF8A62E (0x0C07A0, 0x0BD5AC); FFF8AECE (0x0BD4E0, read) is cal 0x1DE1C (+200 rpm) until the rpm has fallen below FFF8A62E with the pedal still released, then cal 0x1DE20 (+1300 rpm) for cal 0x1DE24 (300 passes = 3 s) and cal 0x1DE1E (+800 rpm) after that until the pedal is pressed (plus cal 0x1DE22 = 0 with A/C), so FFF8A62E (25 rpm units) is the resume rpm. From the rising edge of bit 0 the pass counter FFF8AE16 runs and the stage FFF8A625 = number of boundaries reached (0..4). 0x0BD684 sets limit state FFF8A638 = 8 (engine running; state 9 has priority) once bit 0 has been set for Decel Fuel Cut Delay (059D44) passes; in state 8, 0x0B9EF0 makes the torque cap FFF8AE58 = f x gross torque estimate FFF8AF40 - losses FFF8AF62 with f = (cal 0x23D53/54/55/56 - 1)/256 = 191/127/63/9 for stages 1-4 (stage 0: no reduction), and 0x0B9DC8 selects it as the final cap FFF8AE54. 0x0C1AC8 turns the resulting torque ratio FFF8A64F (0x0C4BA0) into the number of cylinders cut FFF8A643 using the same cals as thresholds (>= 192: none, >= 128: 1, >= 64: 2, >= 10: 3, else 4), so stage n asks for n cylinders cut (read; FFF8A643 is the cylinder-cut count of round 3, also read by the fuel factor 0x0C558C and flag bits FFF8A64C 0-2; its path to the injectors was not traced here). Values should rise along each row. Gear 0 uses the gear 1 table and gears above 6 the gear 6 table. With FFF88ADA bit 6 set (neutral switch on the MT coding) all four boundaries come from Decel Fuel Cut Staging Time (Neutral) instead. Cruise: while cruise control is active (FFF88E12 bit 1) and speed minus target FFF8B9C4 < cal 0x20EC2 (2.5 km/h), with FFF88E11 bit 6 and FFF8A8A4 bit 4 clear, the stage is held at 0 for up to cal 0x20EC0 (1800 passes = 18 s); when the hold ends because the cruise condition drops, the held time (capped at the first boundary) counts toward the first boundary; when it ends by reaching cal 0x20EC0 the held time is discarded and staging starts from 0 (0x0B9A8A-0x0B9AA8 and 0x0B9B1E, read). 'Decel fuel cut' is the reading of a closed-pedal, rpm-hysteresis condition whose output is a cylinder cut count (inferred name, mechanism read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Surge Damping Timing Curve (AT/CVT Gear 1)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1).
Details: When used: AT/CVT only (FFF88ADA bit 7 clear; it is always set on this manual coding), gear FFF88FCE = 1 (0x0DBB20, read: the AT/CVT curve branch, mirrored by the MT branch that reads Surge Damping Timing Curve (Gear 1); the MT coding flag s4 picks the MT curve). Full-scale timing correction (degrees, negative = retard) by the largest throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE since the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 set (0x0DBB20 holds the maximum in FFF8B0F0 and resets it to 0 while the trigger is clear, read), before the phase, coolant, mode and cal factors (read). Surge damping term FFF8A758 (0x0DBB20, called from the 10 ms module 0x0DE0E0; stack args verified with callers.py: s0 = gear FFF88FCE, s4 = MT coding FFF88ADA bit 7, s8 = FFF8B0EE, s12 = rpm FFF8CE9C, s16 = FFF88C64 bit 5, s20 = combustion mode FFF8A85C, read): A758 = Curve(FFF8B0EE) x PhaseFactor(FFF8A75E) x CoolantFactor FFF8A75C x ModeFactor(A85C) x cal factor (MT coding: cal 0x306E5 = 254, or cal 0x306E7 = 128 once FFF88C64 bit 5 has been clear for cal 0x306E8 = 150 passes) / 255^4, in 0.5-degree units, capped at +63.5 degrees, and 0 when the trigger FFF8A7A1 bit 2 is clear or when the current swing count has lasted longer than its time cal 0x306EA..0x306FA (100/20/100/10/100/5/100/100/100 passes of 10 ms for counts 0..8) (read). A758 is added to the final timing sum in 0x0D9E40 (read), so negative values retard. Trigger (read): 0x0DC1E8 counts passes while FFF8A7A1 bit 3 is set, the throttle-flow change FFF8B0EE >= cal 0x3084E (131 = 0.4 % per 20 ms, MT; hysteresis 0x3084C) and FFF8B112 (0x0E0D14 of FFF88A3A) <= cal 0x30842; 0x0E1350 sets FFF8A7A1 bit 2 when that count exceeds a per-gear, per-rpm-band threshold (cals 0x30F62..0x30FAC); it is dropped after cal 0x30850 (90) active passes. FFF8A75E counts rpm swings (0x0DC324, see p17p_surge_phase). FFF88FCE is the gear: on the MT coding 0x08254C copies FFF8A8B6, which 0x11422C derives from the ratio gear FFF8A623 (read). Reading: a timing intervention after a throttle step that retards while rpm swings up and releases while it swings down, i.e. driveline surge (shuffle) damping. Confidence: read.

table.name: A/C Cut Timing Retard Step (Alternate Logic)
table.description:
Alternate A/C-switch timing retard amount, by an unidentified input.
0x0D8E3C (called from 0x0DF02C; args read: FFF88A2D bit 0, cal 0x1D0AE bit 0, FFF8A9A3 bit 0, FFF8A9A2 bit 6, FFF8A65F bit 7) loads FFF8B0CC with this table (by FFF8A8C7) instead of cal 0x2FE82 (2560 = 5 degrees) only when its second argument, the calibration bit 0x1D0AE bit 0, is set. With that bit set the trigger also changes from the A/C engagement edge (FFF8A9A2 bit 6) to FFF8A9A3 bit 0. B0CC >> 8 is subtracted from the final timing sum (0x0D9E40) while the A/C Cut Timing Retard Hold counter runs, then decays (read). Axis FFF8A8C7 is not identified: 0x116034 writes it as a latched copy of FFF8A8C6 (latch conditions involve FFF88B8B bit 0 and FFF8A9A3 bit 1; not worked out in detail), and FFF8A8C6 comes from 0x115F80, which takes it from FFF88B91 (a received input byte, meaning not identified); FFF8A8C6 is read by several other functions together with the same cal bit 0x1D0AE bit 0 (read). Confidence: read.

table.name: Closed-Pedal Timing Target (AT Drive Range)
table.description:
AT version of Closed-Pedal Timing Target, used with the pedal released while the transmission is probably in a drive range.
Details: When used: only with the automatic coding (FFF886AB bit 7 clear), while the debounced range state FFF8A7D9 (0x0EA0E0 from FFF8CE63, which 0x06B68C builds from the discrete inputs FFF8A2A1) is 1 or 2 (in a drive range, inferred). Never on a manual car (read). Same role as Closed-Pedal Timing Target. Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1, AT/CVT)
table.description:
AT/CVT copy of Start Spark Target Base (Mode 1).
Details: When used: FFF8A7E2 bit 0 clear (never on the manual coding), FFF899D7 bit 0 clear. 0x108BAC (catalyst-heating module, read) writes FFF8A854, which 0x0C3200 selects as the spark target FFF8A647 in fuel mode FFF8A852 = 2 (combustion mode FFF8A85C 1 or 3, 0x108B08). A647 is the spark the torque model compensates for (0x0C2514, 0x0C1EA8) and the reference of the cold-start retard monitors (0x1CB70C, 0x132568: A72A - A854) (read); the fired spark in this mode follows FFF8A74C/FFF8A76B (0x0DA428), not A854 (read). In combustion mode 1 (A85C < 2), at <= 4000 rpm (cal 0x1CBD8), with the pedal released (FFF886AB bit 5) and speed below cal 0x2A0C1 (2 km/h): A854 = Base(rpm FFF8CD5C, coolant) + Torque Adder(FFF8A85E, coolant) + Run-Time Adder(passes since the engine state became running, coolant) + Re-Entry Adder(passes since mode 1 was re-entered from normal mode 4, coolant), saturated to a byte; the set is chosen by FFF8A7E2 bit 0 (set = the manual tables, clear = the "AT/CVT" tables; always set on the manual coding, Phase 14) and FFF899D7 bit 0 (set = the "Warm-Up Fallback" tables): a once-per-drive warm-up fallback latch set by 0x081EFC only when cal 0x59134 bit 0 is set. Otherwise in mode 1 A854 = 05D0BC x 05D0A8 / 256 + FFF8A789 - 32; in mode 3 A854 = A72A (normal target) (read). with cal 0x2996C bit 6 set A854 is forced to cal 0x2A0C0. Units: A854 is compared with A72A and final timing in 0.5 degree units (inferred). Evidence: 0x0F4060 (pair of 0x108BAC; identical in LV9N101C/LV9N100F): only two lookup groups, no alternate set (no counterpart of ref selector param_15; the disassembly loads exactly the 10 descriptors 0x50B4C..0x50C00 and 0x50B9C/0x50BB0); group 1 used when param_6 && p7 < cal 0x26035 (= ref !(0x2A0C1 <= p7)) && param_14, group 2 when param_14 == 0, as in the ref. group 2, base (read). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT)
table.description:
Drive mode 1: the default set (used when no SI-Drive request is received; the only set on cars without SI-Drive). On the AT/CVT coding this is the whole requested-torque map for this drive mode (Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default) is then ignored); unused on manual cars. Edit it, and its Monitor copy, when tuning an AT/CVT car.
Details: When used: whenever FFF88ADA bit 7 (manual-transmission coding) is clear, i.e. on the AT/CVT coding. The A/B weight FFF8AE26 (0x0B9C78) starts at 0 and its step cals 0x22FBE/0x22FC0 are 0, so it stays 0 and the output is this table alone; the matching non-AT/CVT table is then ignored (read). FFF88ADA bit 7 is set on the manual coding, so this table is unused on manual cars. Driver-requested torque from rpm and pedal (0x0BB670, read): FFF8AEB4 = A x FFF8AE26/32768 + B x (1 - FFF8AE26/32768), torque above the zero point, into FFF8AEB4; FFF8AE26 ramps between 0 and 32768 under a condition (0x0B9C78). Table B of map set 2 = Drive Mode 1, Default (0x0BDBD8 combines the four sets by the drive-mode byte FFF8A8C1 and per-mode scale cals 0x1FAFE-0x1FB00; SI-Drive positions: mode 4 = Sport Sharp, mode 2 = Sport, mode 3 = Intelligent (least torque for a given pedal in both images), mode 1 = the default used when no valid SI-Drive request is received, and the only set on cars without SI-Drive). KEEP Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor) identical (inferred safety copy). Confidence: inferred.

table.name: Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT, Monitor)
table.description:
Monitor copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT): keep identical to it or expect a throttle plausibility fault. Used only on the AT/CVT coding.
Details: When used: Monitor copy; keep identical. Byte-for-byte copy of Requested Torque (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT) (data and axes) in separate storage, read by a second module (0x1873C4/0x1874BC/0x1875BC/0x1876BC, rpm x FFF88FE2, same A-then-B lookup order and weight structure, into FFF8BBAE/BBB2/BBB6/BBBA). Almost certainly the electronic-throttle torque monitor: change it together with the primary map or expect a throttle/torque plausibility fault (inferred). Confidence: inferred.

table.description:

table.name: Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default, AT/CVT Coding)
table.description:
AT/CVT version of Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default). Only used on an AT/CVT-coded car, so it has no effect on a manual.
Details: When used: drive mode other than 2/3/4 (1, default) with AT/CVT Coding. AT/CVT Coding set = FFF88ADA bit 7 clear and FFF8AE0A >= cal 0x1FC96 (5). Replaces Target Torque Rise Step Stage 1 (Drive Mode 1, Default) (0598F8) as Step1 (read: the selection at 0x0BCB12..0x0BCC20). 0x0BB958 (read; called from the torque module 0x0BE694 at 0x0BF612 with the limited request FFF8AEC2, the previous output FFF8AEC6, gear FFF8A621, rpm FFF8CD54, drive mode FFF8A8C1, pedal FFF8AF00 and, as stack argument 11, cal 0x23704 bit 6; argument order checked in the disassembly). Main path: with prev = FFF8AEC6, if prev + Step1 < Stage 2 Torque the shaped value is max(Start Torque, prev + Step1), otherwise max(Stage 2 Torque, prev + Step2); Step2 the same with cal 0x1FCA2.. (1, 2, 5, 5, 5) and the Stage 2 Pedal Multiplier; the gear factors apply only while FFF8A63D bit 4 is set (else x1). FFF8AEBE = min(request FFF8AEC2, shaped value). No shaping (FFF8AEBE = request) while the request is below Start Torque, vehicle speed FFF88BE8 is below cal 0x1FCAC (hysteresis 0x1FCAE), or FFF88ADA bit 6 / FFF88E62 bit 0 is set. FFF8AEBE goes on through FFF8AEC6 = max(FFF8AEBE, FFF8AEA8) (0x0BD3F0) to the target torque FFF8AECA (boost target / wastegate duty axis). Its rpm axis (0x2000A) differs from the manual table's. The torque monitor 0x1877B4 reads the same data bytes through its own descriptor (05F674), so it stays consistent. Confidence: inferred.

table.description:
